static_traits.name: Lin Kailin
static_traits.social_status: Has a few close friends to confide in, but interpersonal relationships are somewhat tense due to frequent self-doubt and reassurance-seeking; work performance not yet affected; self-esteem issues in daily life have affected participation in hobbies like geocaching.
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness.
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logic, capable of self-reflection, highly cooperative; reporting anxiety and inferiority, but willing to try recording and communication strategies.

basic_info.main_problem: I feel my piano teacher is always late because she wants to spend less time with me, because I am terrible. These thoughts make me feel lack of motivation, anxiety, and unease, affecting my interest in and dedication to learning piano.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these negative thoughts are affecting my motivation to learn piano and my enjoyment of the process.

core_beliefs: I am a terrible / not talented enough person
I am not worthy of others investing time and energy in me

special_situations.event: Piano teacher arriving late to lessons (fairly often)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others are late for me or do not respond promptly, it means I am not important; I am not good enough.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to 'compensate' for inadequacy by practicing doubly hard, arriving early, and inwardly reproaching herself, while avoiding direct communication with the teacher to avoid being negated.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She is unwilling to teach me because I am too terrible.

special_situations.event: Comparing with other classmates in the class (progress/level)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not as good as my peers, it equals failure, showing I am essentially very bad.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Does harsh self-evaluation, extends practice time to prove one's worth.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them, I am very bad, not worth the teacher's investment.

special_situations.event: Just started Learning piano only a few months ago, facing the pressure of a new skill and uncertainty
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot learn quickly or perform perfectly, it proves I will never learn, I am just not capable.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focus attention on mistakes and shortcomings, trying to eliminate unease through more practice.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot learn this, I have never been capable.

special_situations.event: Friends comfort and affirm my piano practice performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Outside positive feedback is not reliable/does not count, only a perfect performance can prove I am not bad.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keep seeking reassurance, but quickly negate its value after receiving reassurance.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just saying nice things, this does not mean I can really do it.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen, accepted, and taken seriously (hopes the teacher recognizes and invests)
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being belittled or rejected for not being good enough, worrying that intimate contact will expose one's own shortcomings
defense_goal: Gain a sense of control over uncertainty through self-deprecation and attributing the cause to oneself
Stay indirect and avoidant (not communicating directly with the teacher) to reduce the risk of explicit rejection

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough Student/a person not worth investing in
object_relations.object_representation: A cold or avoidant authority figure (a person not willing to invest effort)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When an important other (such as the teacher) is late or gives unclear feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Project the Fear of one's own shortcomings onto the other's negative intent ('she is avoiding me/does not want to teach me')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Uncertain tone, repeatedly guessing the other's intent, tending to use self-blaming or speculative phrasing (such as 'is it because I am too bad'), avoiding direct verification.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to communicate directly with the teacher to clarify
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equate expressing needs with offending or inviting negate (fearing Being rejected)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Minimize expression of one's own needs, use vague and Displacement language (such as 'forget it, it does not matter'), light tone, avoid making specific requests.

manifestations: During the vulnerable period of Learning a new skill, interpret the teacher's lateness as a negate of the self, feeling isolated from others
Relationships with friends become tense from frequent reassurance-seeking, yet have not yet truly expressed the deep sense of insecurity
outcomes: Decreased motivation, reduced investment in piano practice and interest activities (such as geocaching)

manifestations: Negative self-labeling and mind reading reduce the sense of meaning and worth of practicing piano
Positive feedback is negated, making it hard to gain a sense of meaning from progress
outcomes: Avoids direct communication, maintaining the negative cycle

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: Not communicating directly with the teacher, instead directing energy toward self-reproach and extra practice
Suppress the urge to express needs when feeling awkward and fearing Being rejected

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Attribute the Fear of one's own 'not good enough' to the teacher 'wanting to reduce time spent with me'
Speculates about others' negative intentions without evidence

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequent Self-doubt and self-blame, over-attention to others' evaluations
Repeatedly seeking reassurance in relationships and believing positive feedback 'does not count'

positive_force: Has some self-awareness and Reflection ability, willing to try recording and restructuring thoughts
Has basic social support (a few close friends)
Clear motivation to seek help; willing to try self-monitoring and communicating with others
Occupational and academic functioning remain stable
negative_force: Self-doubt is marked, tending toward external validation (seeking reassurance)
Mind reading, negating positive evidence, excessive comparison and other cognitive distortions maintain Anxiety
Avoiding direct communication, individually interpreting others' behavior (personalization)
Self-labeling leads to low self-esteem and Decreased motivation

target_behavior.behavior: When the teacher is late, Significant anxiety and self-blame arise, with mind reading and personalizing Interpretation
antecedent: Piano teacher arriving late to class
Lacking immediate information feedback while waiting
target_behavior.core_reason: Attribute others' lateness as evidence of one's own poor ability, accompanied by catastrophic inferences about Being rejected/not being valued.
target_behavior.function: Gain a brief sense of control over uncertainty through self-blame and mind reading, avoiding the Being rejected risk that direct verification might bring.
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety and low self-esteem worsen, LearningDecreased motivation, interest in piano practice declines.

target_behavior.behavior: Excessively seeks comfort and affirmation from others
antecedent: When feeling one's performance was not good after practicing piano
target_behavior.core_reason: Inner evaluation is fragile, relying on external recognition to maintain a sense of self-worth.
target_behavior.function: Gaining short-term emotional relief and security.
target_behavior.consequence: Dependence grows, positive feedback is negated, Interpersonal tension, long-term helplessness worsens.

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids communicating directly with teachers to clarify reasons for lateness
antecedent: Feeling awkward/fearing Being rejected at the thought of discussing scheduling with the teacher
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being negated or confirming 'I am not good enough', thus avoiding verification.
target_behavior.function: Avoid possible negative evaluation or conflict, reducing Anxiety in the short term.
target_behavior.consequence: Misunderstandings and uncertainty persist, maintaining negative automatic thoughts and emotional distress.
